P1.title: The wings of innovation: Direct air connectivity boosts intercity collaborative patenting in China

P2.title: Land collateralization without capitalization: The missing De Soto effect in China's agricultural land mortgage reform

P3.title: Expanding the wealth concept: How pension wealth shapes wealth inequality in China

P4.title: Navigating climate shocks: The macroeconomic and financial stabilizing role of government-led resilience investments

P5.title: Capital goods trade liberalization and firm innovation: Evidence from China

P6.title: International anti-tax avoidance, tax fairness and domestic tax compliance

P7.title: Does the mobile application sales channel strengthen insurance inclusion? Evidence from critical illness insurance

P8.title: From two heads to one: Electoral and governance consequences of political recentralization

P9.title: Exchange rate exposure and global sourcing reconfiguration

P10.title: The power of certainty: how national treatment is reshaping FDI in China

P11.title: Beyond the patient's story: Relational testimonies and medical crowdfunding outcomes in China

P12.title: The employment effects of ICT investment: evidence from China

source.en: Survey and Research Center for China Household Finance, SWUFE
source.zh: 西南财经大学中国家庭金融调查与研究中心

description.en: A nationally representative household survey conducted by Southwestern University of Finance and Economics. The linked study uses its individual-level information to estimate pension wealth and examine wealth distribution.
description.zh: 西南财经大学开展的全国性家庭调查。所列研究使用其中的个人层面信息估算养老金财富并考察财富分配。

source.en: Institute of Social Science Survey, Peking University
source.zh: 北京大学中国社会科学调查中心

source.en: Institute of Social Science Survey, Peking University
source.zh: 北京大学中国社会科学调查中心

source.en: Institute of Social Science Survey, Peking University
source.zh: 北京大学中国社会科学调查中心

description.en: A longitudinal survey conducted by the Institute of Social Science Survey at Peking University, covering individuals and households. The linked studies use demographic, education, employment, pension participation and local-government attitude information.
description.zh: 北京大学中国社会科学调查中心开展的个人与家庭追踪调查。所列研究使用人口特征、教育、就业、养老保险参与及对地方政府态度等信息。

source.en: China Institute for Income Distribution, Beijing Normal University
source.zh: 北京师范大学中国收入分配研究院

description.en: A household survey conducted by the China Institute for Income Distribution at Beijing Normal University. The linked study uses its social pension participation information for comparison with other household surveys.
description.zh: 北京师范大学中国收入分配研究院开展的住户调查。所列研究使用其中的社会养老保险参与信息，与其他家庭调查进行比较。

name.zh: 中国农村家庭追踪调查

source.zh: 浙江大学中国家庭大数据库

description.en: A rural household and community survey provided through Zhejiang University's Chinese Family Database. It contains household socioeconomic information and village-level information on leadership, elections and governance.
description.zh: 由浙江大学中国家庭数据库提供的农村家庭与社区调查，包含家庭社会经济状况以及村庄领导、选举和治理等信息。

name.zh: 中国人口普查汇总资料

source.en: National Bureau of Statistics; provincial statistics bureaus
source.zh: 国家统计局及各省统计局

source.en: National Bureau of Statistics; provincial statistics bureaus
source.zh: 国家统计局及各省统计局

access.en: Public study extracts; some originals by application
access.zh: 研究用整理表公开；部分原始表需申请

description.en: Population census statistics compiled by China's National Bureau of Statistics. The linked studies use published tabulations of population, education, employment and other demographic characteristics, including detailed industry and occupation tables.
description.zh: 国家统计局编制的人口普查统计资料。所列研究使用人口、教育、就业等公开汇总资料，包括行业和职业的详细分类表。

name.zh: IPUMS中国人口普查微观样本

source.zh: 明尼苏达大学IPUMS International

description.en: Harmonized census microdata distributed by IPUMS International at the University of Minnesota. The China samples used here contain person-level demographic, industry, occupation and geographic information.
description.zh: 明尼苏达大学 IPUMS International 提供的标准化人口普查微观资料。所列研究使用的中国样本包含个人层面的人口特征、行业、职业及地理信息。

source.zh: 美国橡树岭国家实验室

description.en: A gridded population product from Oak Ridge National Laboratory. The linked study aggregates the population grids to city and county areas.
description.zh: 美国橡树岭国家实验室提供的栅格人口产品。所列研究将栅格人口汇总至城市和县域。

source.zh: 轻松筹；作者采集的众筹页面

access.en: Public anonymized data; full text withheld
access.zh: 匿名数据公开；完整文本不公开

description.en: An author-collected source based on medical crowdfunding campaigns on Qschou. It covers campaign characteristics, fundraising outcomes and information derived from testimonials; the public documentation distinguishes released material from withheld identifiable text.
description.zh: 作者根据轻松筹医疗众筹项目整理，包含项目特征、筹款结果及从证言中提取的信息。公开说明区分了已发布材料与未公开的可识别身份文本。

name.en: Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (QCEW)
name.zh: 美国就业与工资季度普查

source.zh: 美国劳工统计局

description.en: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics' Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages provides employment and wage statistics by geography and industry. The linked study uses county-industry employment information.
description.zh: 美国劳工统计局的就业与工资季度普查，提供分地区、分行业的就业和工资统计。所列研究使用县与行业层面的就业信息。

source.en: U.S. Department of Labor / O*NET Resource Center
source.zh: 美国劳工部／O*NET资源中心

description.en: An occupational information resource supported by the US Department of Labor. It describes work activities, work context and abilities, which the linked study uses to characterize occupational tasks.
description.zh: 美国劳工部支持的职业信息资源，描述工作活动、工作环境和能力要求；所列研究据此刻画职业任务特征。

source.en: National Bureau of Statistics; institution-held versions
source.zh: 国家统计局；论文使用机构持有版本

source.en: National Bureau of Statistics; institution-held versions
source.zh: 国家统计局；论文使用机构持有版本

description.en: Firm-level industrial survey records from China's National Bureau of Statistics. The linked studies use information on industrial enterprises' production, finances and employment.
description.zh: 国家统计局的工业企业调查资料。所列研究使用工业企业的生产、财务及就业等信息。

source.en: Ministry of Finance; State Taxation Administration
source.zh: 财政部、国家税务总局

description.en: A tax survey administered by China's Ministry of Finance and State Taxation Administration. The linked study uses enterprise financial and tax information to examine tax compliance.
description.zh: 财政部与国家税务总局组织的税收调查。所列研究使用企业财务及税收信息研究税收遵从。

source.zh: 国家知识产权局

access.zh: 原始信息公开；包内仅部分摘录

source.en: School of Economics Data Center, Fudan University; Chinese patent records
source.zh: 复旦大学经济学院数据中心持有的中国专利记录

source.en: Li & Shi, Chinese patent in Google patent public data
source.zh: Li与Shi整理：Google专利公开数据中的中国专利

description.en: Patent records originating from the China National Intellectual Property Administration, accessed through different compilations in the linked studies. They contain patent application and applicant information used to study innovation, collaboration and knowledge flows.
description.zh: 源自国家知识产权局、经不同渠道整理的专利记录，包含专利申请及申请人信息，用于研究创新、合作与知识流动。

name.en: RStata Supply Chain and Patent Data
name.zh: 上市公司供应链与专利数据

source.zh: RStata数据中心

description.en: Supplier-customer and patent-related panels supplied by the RStata Data Center. The linked study uses them to measure intercity production linkages and patent similarity.
description.zh: RStata 数据中心提供的供应商—客户及专利相关面板资料。所列研究据此衡量城市之间的生产联系和专利相似性。

source.zh: 中国研究数据服务平台（CNRDS）

description.en: Patent-transfer records supplied by CNRDS. The linked study uses these records to construct measures of patent transfers between cities.
description.zh: 中国研究数据服务平台提供的专利转让记录。所列研究据此构建城市之间的专利转让指标。

name.zh: 中国工商注册企业数据

source.en: NECIPS; authorized access via Xiamen University
source.zh: 国家企业信用信息公示系统；厦门大学授权获取

description.en: Enterprise registration records from the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System, accessed through an authorized institutional source. The linked study uses registration and ownership information to identify foreign-invested enterprises.
description.zh: 源自国家企业信用信息公示系统、通过获授权的机构渠道取得的企业登记资料。所列研究使用注册及所有制信息识别外商投资企业。

source.zh: 国际机器人联合会

description.en: World Robotics statistics from the International Federation of Robotics. The linked study uses industrial robot stocks by country and industry to measure robot exposure.
description.zh: 国际机器人联合会的 World Robotics 统计资料。所列研究使用分国家、分行业的工业机器人存量衡量机器人暴露程度。

source.zh: CSMAR数据中心
CSMAR数据中心

description.en: CSMAR databases covering listed companies' financial statements and related corporate information. The linked studies use firm finances and registered capital, among other company characteristics.
description.zh: 国泰安提供的上市公司财务报表及相关企业信息数据库。所列研究使用公司财务、注册资本等企业特征。

name.en: CSMAR China Bank Research Database – Finance
name.zh: CSMAR中国银行财务研究数据库

source.zh: CSMAR数据中心

description.en: Bank financial and profile information supplied by CSMAR. It includes balance-sheet and income-statement information used to construct bank-level financial indicators.
description.zh: 国泰安提供的银行财务与基本情况资料，包含资产负债表及利润表信息，用于构建银行层面的财务指标。

name.zh: 农村商业银行监管数据

source.zh: 原银监会、银保监会；研究合作取得

description.en: Supervisory records on rural commercial banks from China's former banking regulators, CBRC and CBIRC. They cover assets, lending, capital, ownership and operating indicators.
description.zh: 原中国银监会与中国银保监会的农村商业银行监管资料，涵盖资产、贷款、资本、所有权及经营指标。

name.zh: 浙大卡特—企研中国涉农研究数据库

source.en: China Academy for Rural Development, Zhejiang University; Qiyan Data
source.zh: 浙江大学中国农村发展研究院、企研数据

description.en: Agricultural research databases provided by Zhejiang University's CARD and Qiyan. The linked study uses prefecture-level counts of family farms, farmers' professional cooperatives and agricultural enterprises.
description.zh: 浙江大学卡特与企研提供的涉农研究数据库。所列研究使用地级市层面的家庭农场、农民专业合作社及农业企业数量信息。

name.en: Critical Illness Insurance Policy and Claims Data
name.zh: 重大疾病保险保单与理赔数据

source.en: A private life insurer in China (unnamed)
source.zh: 中国一家民营寿险公司（未披露名称）

access.zh: 汇总数据公开；微观数据不公开

description.en: Policy and claims records supplied by an unnamed life insurer. The linked study uses insurance purchasing, coverage and claims information; the insurer's identity is not disclosed in the public README.
description.zh: 由一家未具名寿险公司提供的保单与理赔记录。所列研究使用保险购买、保障及理赔信息；公开 README 未披露公司名称。

name.en: CSMAR China Regional Economy Research Database
name.zh: CSMAR中国区域经济研究数据库

source.zh: CSMAR数据中心

description.en: Regional economic and financial statistics distributed by CSMAR. The linked study uses city-level bank loan and deposit balances.
description.zh: 国泰安提供的区域经济与金融统计资料。所列研究使用城市层面的银行贷款及存款余额。

name.en: China Customs Import and Export Data
name.zh: 中国海关进出口微观数据

source.en: General Administration of Customs; institution-held versions
source.zh: 海关总署；论文使用机构持有版本

source.en: General Administration of Customs; RESSET via Tsinghua University
source.zh: 海关总署；清华大学订阅的锐思海关全口岸数据库

description.en: Import and export records originating from the General Administration of Customs of China. They describe firms' trade by product and trading partner, with access channels differing across the linked studies.
description.zh: 源自中国海关总署的进出口记录，包含企业分产品、分贸易伙伴的贸易信息；所列研究的获取渠道有所不同。

source.zh: 世界银行WITS、UNCTAD TRAINS

description.en: Product-level tariff schedules from UNCTAD TRAINS, accessed through World Bank trade-data services. The linked study uses most-favoured-nation tariffs for China and foreign markets.
description.zh: 联合国贸发会议 TRAINS 的产品层面关税资料，通过世界银行贸易数据服务获取。所列研究使用中国及国外市场的最惠国关税。

source.en: Civil Aviation Administration of China; Civil Aviation Statistical Yearbook
source.zh: 中国民航局、民航统计年鉴

description.en: Air-route information compiled from the Civil Aviation Administration of China's statistical yearbooks and official route announcements. The linked study uses flight segments to identify air connections between cities.
description.zh: 根据中国民用航空局统计年鉴及官方航线公告整理的航线信息。所列研究使用航段资料识别城市之间的航空联系。

source.zh: 法国国际经济研究中心（CEPII）

description.en: CEPII's product-level bilateral trade database. It provides trade flows between countries classified by product.
description.zh: 法国国际经济研究中心的产品层面双边贸易数据库，提供按产品分类的国家间贸易流量信息。

source.zh: 天气网

description.en: Historical daily weather information published on tianqi.com. The source used here reports maximum and minimum temperature, weather descriptions and wind, supporting the study's extreme-temperature measures.
description.zh: 天气网发布的历史逐日天气信息。所用来源记录最高和最低气温、天气状况及风况，用于构建极端温度指标。

source.zh: CRED／UCLouvain

description.en: The international disaster database maintained by CRED at UCLouvain. Its country profiles report disaster occurrences and impacts; the linked study uses information on natural disasters and economic damage.
description.zh: 比利时鲁汶大学灾害流行病学研究中心维护的国际灾害数据库。其国家概况资料记录灾害发生及影响，所列研究使用自然灾害及经济损失信息。

source.en: China Meteorological Administration; National Climate Centre
source.zh: 中国气象局、国家气候中心

description.en: An official climate bulletin published by the China Meteorological Administration. The linked study draws on its reported flood-related economic losses.
description.zh: 中国气象局发布的官方气候公报。所列研究使用其中公布的洪涝灾害经济损失信息。

source.en: National Bureau of Statistics of China
source.zh: 国家统计局

description.en: National GDP statistics published by China's National Bureau of Statistics. The linked study uses GDP to express disaster-related economic losses relative to the size of the economy.
description.zh: 国家统计局公布的全国国内生产总值统计。所列研究以 GDP 衡量灾害经济损失相对于经济规模的大小。

source.en: EPS China Data; original statistics from NBS
source.zh: EPS数据平台；原始统计来自国家统计局

description.en: Chinese macroeconomic series distributed through EPS China Data. The linked study uses exchange-rate and national patent series sourced from official Chinese statistics.
description.zh: EPS 中国数据提供的中国宏观经济序列。所列研究使用源自中国官方统计的汇率及全国专利序列。

source.zh: 国际货币基金组织

description.en: Exchange-rate series from the International Monetary Fund. The linked study uses monthly currency rates against the US dollar to construct bilateral exchange rates against the renminbi.
description.zh: 国际货币基金组织的汇率序列。所列研究使用各币种对美元的月度汇率，构建其对人民币的双边汇率。

source.zh: 世界银行
世界银行

description.en: The World Bank's World Development Indicators brings together country-level development statistics. The linked studies use land area, GDP and consumer price information.
description.zh: 世界银行世界发展指标汇集国家层面的发展统计。所列研究使用国土面积、GDP 及消费价格信息。

source.zh: CEIC数据库
CEIC数据库

description.en: Economic time series distributed by CEIC. The linked studies use Chinese regional indicators such as GDP, industrial structure, government expenditure and trade.
description.zh: CEIC 提供的经济时间序列。所列研究使用中国地区 GDP、产业结构、财政支出及贸易等指标。

name.en: China City and Regional Statistical Yearbooks
name.zh: 中国城市及地区统计年鉴

source.en: National Bureau of Statistics; regional statistics bureaus
source.zh: 国家统计局及地方统计局

access.zh: 已出版统计表／图书馆获取

source.en: National Bureau of Statistics; regional statistics bureaus
source.zh: 国家统计局及地方统计局

access.zh: 已出版统计表／图书馆获取

source.en: National Bureau of Statistics; regional statistics bureaus
source.zh: 国家统计局及地方统计局

access.zh: 已出版统计表／图书馆获取

source.en: National Bureau of Statistics; regional statistics bureaus
source.zh: 国家统计局及地方统计局

access.zh: 已出版统计表／图书馆获取

description.en: Statistical yearbooks issued by national and local statistical authorities. They report city, county or provincial economic and social indicators, including population, output, public finances and employment.
description.zh: 国家及地方统计部门出版的统计年鉴，提供城市、县域或省级经济社会指标，包括人口、产出、财政及就业等信息。

source.en: National Bureau of Statistics of China
source.zh: 国家统计局

description.en: The China Statistical Yearbook is published by the National Bureau of Statistics. The linked study uses information on government employment and rural household income, including transfer income.
description.zh: 国家统计局出版的《中国统计年鉴》。所列研究使用政府就业及农村家庭收入资料，包括转移性收入。

source.en: National Bureau of Statistics of China
source.zh: 国家统计局

description.en: Input-output tables published by China's National Bureau of Statistics. They record flows across industries and final uses, including fixed capital formation.
description.zh: 国家统计局发布的投入产出表，记录行业之间的流量及最终使用，包括固定资本形成。

name.zh: RUCioD中国时间序列投入产出表

source.en: Renmin University of China; China Input-Output Association
source.zh: 中国人民大学；中国投入产出学会

description.en: A time-series input-output database from Renmin University of China's School of Applied Economics. The linked study uses its industry tables to construct ICT capital measures.
description.zh: 中国人民大学应用经济学院提供的时间序列投入产出数据库。所列研究使用其中的行业表构建信息通信技术资本指标。

source.zh: Luiss大学EUKLEMS与INTANProd项目

description.en: Industry-level productivity and capital statistics from EUKLEMS & INTANProd. The linked study uses US industry ICT capital series.
description.zh: EUKLEMS & INTANProd 提供的行业生产率及资本统计资料。所列研究使用美国各行业的信息通信技术资本序列。

source.zh: 国际清算银行

description.en: Bilateral exchange-rate series published by the Bank for International Settlements. The linked study uses them to convert trade values from US dollars to renminbi.
description.zh: 国际清算银行发布的双边汇率序列。所列研究用其将以美元计价的贸易额换算为人民币。

source.zh: Dario Caldara与Matteo Iacoviello

description.en: Geopolitical risk indices developed by Dario Caldara and Matteo Iacoviello. The linked study draws on the authors' published GPR series.
description.zh: Dario Caldara 与 Matteo Iacoviello 编制的地缘政治风险指数。所列研究使用两位作者公开发布的 GPR 序列。

source.zh: 格罗宁根增长与发展研究中心

description.en: Penn World Table provides internationally comparable national economic accounts. The linked study uses information on output, population, capital and human capital.
description.zh: 宾大世界表提供可进行跨国比较的国民经济核算资料。所列研究使用产出、人口、资本及人力资本信息。

name.zh: 世界各国外部财富数据库

source.zh: 布鲁金斯学会

description.en: The External Wealth of Nations database compiled by Philip Lane and Gian Maria Milesi-Ferretti reports countries' external financial positions. The linked study uses total external assets.
description.zh: Philip Lane 与 Gian Maria Milesi-Ferretti 编制的 External Wealth of Nations 数据库，记录各国对外金融头寸。所列研究使用对外资产总额。

name.zh: 中国行业信息通信技术资本服务数据

source.zh: Liu与Li的研究复现资料

access.en: Study series provided in replication package

description.en: Industry ICT capital estimates constructed by Liu and Li. The linked study uses these published estimates as an alternative measure of ICT capital.
description.zh: Liu 与 Li 构建的行业信息通信技术资本估计。所列研究将其已公开的估计结果作为 ICT 资本的替代衡量指标。

name.zh: 信息通信技术价格指数

source.en: National Bureau of Statistics; author compilation
source.zh: 国家统计局价格统计；作者整理

description.en: An ICT price index compiled by the authors from National Bureau of Statistics price statistics. It is used as a deflator in the study's ICT capital construction.
description.zh: 作者根据国家统计局价格统计整理的信息通信技术价格指数，用于研究中 ICT 资本构建的价格平减。

source.zh: 百度

access.zh: 公开查询界面／账号访问

description.en: Baidu's search-interest service reports search intensity for selected keywords across regions. The linked study uses searches related to insurance.
description.zh: 百度提供的关键词搜索热度服务，记录不同地区的搜索强度。所列研究使用保险相关关键词的搜索信息。

source.zh: 百度地图

description.en: Points of interest obtained through Baidu Maps. The linked study uses insurance-company locations to measure the local presence of insurance branches.
description.zh: 通过百度地图取得的兴趣点资料。所列研究使用保险机构位置衡量当地保险分支机构的分布。

source.en: Ministry of Civil Affairs; China Statistics Press / China Society Press
source.zh: 民政部；中国统计出版社／中国社会出版社

description.en: The China Civil Affairs Statistical Yearbook is issued by the Ministry of Civil Affairs. It provides information on village and residents' committees, elections and local governance.
description.zh: 民政部出版的《中国民政统计年鉴》，提供村民委员会、居民委员会、选举及基层治理等信息。

source.zh: 中国检察出版社；各省检察院

description.en: Procuratorial yearbooks and provincial procuratorate reports document the work of China's procuratorial authorities. The linked study uses counts of officials investigated for corruption.
description.zh: 检察年鉴及省级检察机关报告记录中国检察机关的工作。所列研究使用被调查腐败官员的数量信息。

source.en: National Platform for Common GeoSpatial Information Services
source.zh: 国家地理信息公共服务平台

description.en: An official national geographic information platform. The linked study uses provincial administrative boundaries and geographic coordinates obtained through Tianditu.
description.zh: 国家地理信息公共服务平台。所列研究使用通过天地图获取的省级行政边界及地理坐标。

name.en: CNRDS Confucian Culture Database — Ming-Qing Jinshi
name.zh: CNRDS儒家文化数据库：明清进士

source.zh: 中国研究数据服务平台（CNRDS）

description.en: The Ming-Qing Jinshi module of CNRDS's Confucian Culture Database records historical imperial examination graduates. The linked study uses prefecture-level Jinshi counts.
description.zh: 中国研究数据服务平台儒家文化数据库的明清进士模块，记录历史科举进士信息。所列研究使用地级市层面的进士数量。

name.en: Free Trade Zone Approvals and Foreign-Investment Catalogues
name.zh: 自贸区批复与外商投资产业目录

source.en: State Council; national foreign-investment policy documents
source.zh: 国务院及国家外商投资政策文件

description.en: Policy information compiled from State Council free-trade-zone approvals and official foreign-investment catalogues. It identifies approved zones and encouraged investment activities.
description.zh: 根据国务院自由贸易试验区批复及官方外商投资目录整理的政策信息，用于识别获批区域及鼓励投资的活动。

source.en: Yan Zhongping et al., Selected Statistical Materials on Modern Chinese Economic History
source.zh: 严中平等《中国近代经济史统计资料选辑》

description.en: Historical treaty-port information drawn from the statistical compilation by Yan Zhongping and coauthors. It records port names, opening dates and provincial locations.
description.zh: 根据严中平等编制的历史统计资料整理的通商口岸信息，包括口岸名称、开埠日期及所在省份。

name.zh: 高德地图县级地理编码

source.zh: 高德地图

description.en: Geocoding information from Amap's mapping service. The linked study converts province, city and county names into geographic coordinates.
description.zh: 高德地图服务提供的地理编码信息。所列研究将省、市、县名称转换为地理坐标。

name.zh: 中国行政区划矢量边界

source.zh: GaryBikini／ChinaAdminDivisonSHP项目

description.en: Chinese administrative boundary shapefiles distributed by GaryBikini through Zenodo. The linked study uses these geographic boundaries for mapping and spatial analysis.
description.zh: GaryBikini 通过 Zenodo 发布的中国行政区划边界文件。所列研究使用这些边界进行制图及空间分析。

source.zh: 各市、省卫生健康委员会

description.en: City-level COVID-19 case information compiled by the authors from municipal and provincial health commission announcements. It records reported daily new cases.
description.zh: 作者根据市级及省级卫生健康委员会公告整理的城市新冠病例信息，记录每日报告的新增病例。
